name: dp-audit
title: Claimed ε against the ε an auditor can actually demonstrate
subtitle: Empirical lower bounds on the privacy loss of DP-SGD. The gap closes almost entirely when the auditor sees every gradient step.
source: Jagielski, Ullman & Oprea 2020, Tables 2–3 (Fashion-MNIST, 500 trials); Nasr et al. 2023, Tables 1–3 (CIFAR-10, ε = 8, δ = 10⁻⁵)
